Canonical force/manner verb for push. It describes exerting force in a pushing relation and does not by itself entail successful displacement; actual caused motion is expressed by the mov-family valency frame.

entries.source: Latin trahere / tract-; international traction-tractor family
entries.decision: Canonical force/manner verb for pull. It describes traction/pulling and does not by itself entail successful displacement; actual caused motion is expressed by the mov-family valency frame.
Canonical vertical-axis root for high/upper/up. With allative -ad, altad marks upward direction/toward a higher position. It may compound transparently with mov: altmov = ascend/go up.
Canonical vertical-axis root for low/lower/down. With allative -ad, basad marks downward direction/toward a lower position. It may compound transparently with mov: basmov = descend/go down.
Canonical transparent motion compound alt+mov for upward motion/ascending. Equivalent directional paraphrase: mov altad. It is distinct from phase-derived admov, which means begin moving.
Canonical transparent motion compound bas+mov for downward motion/descending. Equivalent directional paraphrase: mov basad. It is distinct from phase-derived demov, which means cease moving.
Canonical root for air. Preserves the classical/international aer- family in canonical Unisermo spelling.

entries.source: Latin planus / planum; international plan-/plane family
entries.decision: Canonical root for plane/flat/level. Used as the second component of transparent compound aerplan.

entries.source: productive compound aer + plan; international aeroplane family
entries.decision: Canonical transparent compound aer+plan for airplane/aeroplane. Preferred over aeroplan; the lexical structure is explicitly aer + plan.

entries.decision: Canonize adel as neutral sibling root. This August 10 author-approved choice was omitted from the saved lexicon; explicitly restored by author October 24, replacing obsolete frat.

entries.source: Author-confirmed 2026-08-10 adel + -o masculine sibling formation; restoration 2026-10-24
entries.decision: Canonize adelo = male sibling/brother, derived from neutral adel plus kinship-family ending -o. Replaces retired frat. Not evidence of a universal gender rule across all nouns.

entries.source: Author-confirmed 2026-08-10 adel + -e feminine sibling formation; restoration 2026-10-24
entries.decision: Canonize adele = female sibling/sister, derived from neutral adel plus kinship-family ending -e. Do not generalize this pattern to unconfirmed kinship candidates.
Canonize gen as neutral parent relation, base for geno (father) and gene (mother).
Canonize geno = father, male parent. Sex suffix applies to the immediate parent relation in this confirmed form.
Canonize gene = mother, female parent. Sex suffix applies to the immediate parent relation in this confirmed form.
Canonize adelgen = sibling of a parent. Composition A+B means A relative to B, keeping left and right relation roles distinct.
